messages.author: 361e593259030741
messages.subject: single vs. double quotation inside std::cout
parts:
Hi. 
While printing characters on screen using std::out, my machine is sensitive to whether the quotation is single or double.  For example, 
 
(1) std::cout<<"ABC: "<<std::endl;  
This results in a compile error. 
 vs. 
(2) std:cout<<'ABC: '<<std::endl;    
This passes compile-link, but the character, "ABC" does not show up on the screen.
